latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of MarketPulse—your unified API for real-time and historical equities and crypto data.

- Query prices, news, metrics, and fundamental data for both stocks and cryptocurrencies.
- Access portfolio analysis tools, stock screening, earnings summaries, analyst estimates, insider trades, and institutional ownership.
- Retrieve company financial statements, SEC filings, interest rates, and breaking company news.
- Crypto support for popular coins and tokens, with real-time and historical price endpoints.
- Includes both curl and Python command samples for easy integration.
- Requires only one API key (AISA_API_KEY) for all features.
